description: nf-core/hlatyping samplesheet context, aligned to the pinned 2.2.0 schema. Precision HLA typing with OptiType.

pipeline.name: nf-core/hlatyping
pipeline.core_rule: Columns are sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, bam, seq_type. sample and seq_type are REQUIRED; supply EITHER fastq_1(/fastq_2) OR bam.

validation_rules: The file consumed by the pipeline must be comma-separated (CSV).
Give EITHER fastq_1 (+ optional fastq_2) OR bam for a row — not both.
Do NOT pass --fasta or --gtf: hlatyping's schema declares neither.
notes: OptiType ships its own HLA reference, so this pipeline needs no genome from us — which makes it one of the few that runs on the Luria refs tree as-is.

sources.label: nf-core/hlatyping nextflow_schema.json @ 2.2.0
sources.notes: Authoritative param names, types and defaults for the pinned revision.

sources.label: nf-core/hlatyping assets/schema_input.json @ 2.2.0
sources.notes: Authoritative required/optional samplesheet columns and allowed values.

samplesheet_columns.description: Column-level field dictionary for the nf-core/hlatyping input samplesheet.

sample.description: Custom sample name; repeat across lanes of one library.
sample.validation_hints: Prefer the NExtSEEK D.SEQ UID so results map back to the sample record.

fastq_1.validation_hints: Required unless a bam is given instead.

fastq_2.validation_hints: Blank for single-end; keep the header.

bam.description: Aligned BAM, as an alternative to FASTQ input.
bam.validation_hints: Use EITHER bam OR fastq_1 for a given row, never both.

seq_type.description: Whether the library is DNA (WES/WGS) or RNA.
seq_type.validation_hints: Derive from the sample's assay: RNA-seq libraries are rna, WES/WGS are dna. It changes OptiType's configuration.

report_writer_guidance.purpose: Build an nf-core/hlatyping samplesheet from a resolved NExtSEEK D.SEQ cohort.
report_writer_guidance.workflow_role: Selected when the user asks for HLA typing / HLA alleles.
population_priority: One row per D.SEQ leaf; sample = the UID.
Set seq_type from the sample's assay (RNA-seq -> rna; WES/WGS -> dna). Ask if the assay is ambiguous.
Prefer FASTQ input; use bam only when the cohort has no FASTQ registered.
final_checks: Every row has seq_type set from real assay metadata.
No row carries both bam and fastq_1.
